label: Primary iPhone (anonymised)
nameplate_source: manufacturer specifications supplied with the device
energy_consistency: battery_energy_wh = nominal_voltage_v × rated_capacity_mah / 1000 = 14.351 Wh exactly. cell_energy_wh (14.499) divided by rated capacity gives 3.927 V, i.e. 0.040 V above nominal — the cell-level figure uses a higher reference voltage than the pack rating.
platform_note: 3.887V nominal + 4.50V charge limit = high-voltage / silicon-carbon class cell (standard 4.2V platforms use 3.7V nominal).
health_source: iOS analytics snapshot generated at 08:00 local time on each sample date
charge_limit_voltage_caveat: 4.50V is the cell nameplate hardware ceiling. The iOS software charging target is set separately at or below it and can be stepped down by cycle count; the two are not the same quantity.
